verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents Reusable Content: admins create Markdown blocks that appear across multiple pages, and editing a block updates every instance automatically ("Edit once, update everywhere"). That delivers the core goal of keeping repeated content in sync. The variables half of the story is not documented; the only variable-like evidence is reader-side injection of API keys and server variables. Creating reusable blocks is also limited to Admins. missing for 10: documented writer-defined content variables/placeholders, detail on snippet scope or limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
